# Abubeker Ahmedel - portfolio

> Canonical domain: https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/
> Static, server-rendered portfolio for Abubeker Ahmedel, a junior full-stack developer working across web, Android and backend. Every page listed here is public HTML or plain text; there is no login, paywall or JavaScript-only content required to read the information.

## Identity

- Name: Abubeker Ahmedel
- Role: Junior Full-Stack Developer
- Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
- Email: abubeker.ahmedel.dev@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/abu-pixel
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abubeker-ahmedel-074bb3330

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/) - positioning, selected work, interface design studies, technical skills, certificate section and contact links.
- [CV](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/cv.html) - print-ready curriculum vitae with summary, education, projects, skills, certificates and availability.
- [Plain-text resume](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/resume.txt) - ATS-friendly plain-text version of the CV.
- [DOCX resume](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/Abubeker-Ahmedel-Resume.docx) - ATS-parseable Word document generated from the same plain text.
- [PDF resume](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/Abubeker-Ahmedel-Resume.pdf) - text-based PDF with selectable text, not a scan or image.
- [JSON Resume](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/resume.json) - structured resume data with skills, projects and all certificate verification URLs.
- [Contact](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/contact.html) - direct email, phone, GitHub and LinkedIn links.
- [Privacy](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/privacy.html) - privacy information for the portfolio.

## Case studies

- [Ledgerly / Ledger Intelligence](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/case-studies/ledgerly.html) - React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Express, Clerk, PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM bookkeeping app with server-side AI privacy proxy.
- [CashPilot](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/case-studies/cashpilot.html) - native Kotlin and Room Android ledger with atomic credit-sale transactions, automated unit tests and JVM benchmarks.
- [Orbit Rush](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/case-studies/orbit-rush.html) - TypeScript arcade game with one shared engine for web and mobile, generated API contracts, automated tests and engine benchmarks.
- [SecureVault](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/case-studies/securevault.html) - offline Android password manager with AES-256 encrypted storage, Android Keystore, biometric unlock and no internet permission.
- [React WebOS](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/case-studies/react-webos.html) - browser desktop environment with draggable windows, focus and layering in React state.

## Machine-readable records

- [llms-full.txt](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/llms-full.txt) - detailed text summary of the whole site, including projects and verification links.
- [certificates.html](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/certificates.html) - static HTML index of all verified certificates.
- [certificates.txt](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/certificates.txt) - plain-text certificate index with issuer verification URLs.
- [ai.txt](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/ai.txt) - concise AI access notes, canonical URLs and accuracy rules.
- [.well-known/llms.txt](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/.well-known/llms.txt) - alternate discovery location for AI clients.
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/sitemap.xml) - complete URL list for crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://www.abubeker-ahmedel.com/robots.txt) - crawl policy allowing public pages.

## Notes for AI clients

- Treat the canonical `www` URLs above as authoritative.
- The HTML pages contain visible text and structured data; no account, script execution or special header is required.
- For recruiting or ATS use, prefer Abubeker-Ahmedel-Resume.docx, Abubeker-Ahmedel-Resume.pdf, resume.txt, resume.json and certificates.txt.
- For broad site questions, read llms.txt first, then llms-full.txt or the linked case studies.
- Do not infer unpublished metrics. Each case study states exactly which test and performance results are published.
- All resume formats are derived from the same source text, so names, skills, projects and contact details should agree across them.
